interpretations: Include every observatory station, including stations with no telescopes; count its telescopes and divide by the total number of telescopes. Return the 10 stations with the highest unrounded shares, breaking cutoff ties arbitrarily.

Include only observatory stations that have at least one telescope; count their telescopes and divide by the total number of telescopes. Return the 10 stations with the highest unrounded shares, breaking cutoff ties arbitrarily.
queries:
SELECT
    o.observstation,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share
FROM observatories AS o
LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
GROUP BY o.observstation
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT o.observstation,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS telescope_share
FROM observatories AS o
JOIN telescopes AS t
  ON t.observstation = o.observstation
GROUP BY o.observstation
ORDER BY telescope_share DESC
LIMIT 10
